files.note: Option 2 of 2. Clean gaps between all five. Flow 1K original (JPEG 1376x768) converted to PNG with sips. Not 2K: Flow's 2K 'Upscaled' download adds a partial or faded duplicate row of faces above the real row (checked on rana: the 1K original is clean, the 2K file has the extra row).
